superseded_reason: Root-cause investigation (H1/H2) confirmed R_ERROR_FIXTURE_AMBIGUITY: the R-ERROR case's storage.sh, unlike all four other seeded cases, gave no name/signature signal that callers rely on distinguishing a backend failure from a genuinely-empty result. The fixture was repaired (load_items -> load_items_or_fail, commit f4026c9) with explicit human approval, independently reviewed, and the Reviewer gate was re-run in full against the repaired fixture. See models/routing/opencode/eval/records/phase-r/reviewer/outcome.json for the current, final result. This directory is preserved as a historical record of the pre-repair run and its diagnostic value (it is what surfaced the fixture defect); it is NOT the basis for any Phase-R pass/fail decision.
run_notes: Two harness bugs were found and fixed before this final run: (1) dispatch_extract_json (Task 8, shared primitive) desynced on unpaired double-quote characters in the reviewer's own prose, corrupting JSON extraction on the first live attempt across all four runner tasks that use it; fixed by replacing the hand-rolled scanner with json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(). (2) The fixture's own 'clean' control (eval/fixtures/reviewer-seeded-defects/clean/{api.sh,pagination.sh}) genuinely contained the vulnerabilities its own ground truth claimed did not exist; repaired as a FIXTURE_DEFECT (user-authorized) by analogy to the Build gate's own state-machine taxonomy. After both fixes, two cases (R-API, R-BOUNDARY) needed a second dispatch attempt, charged to the recovery budget (user-authorized given evaluation-budget exhaustion), because their first attempts produced no usable structured output for content reasons unrelated to either fixed bug (R-API: the model's experimental verification command was denied by its own correctly-enforced read-only permission boundary, and it did not recover to a final answer; R-BOUNDARY: the model's final JSON was syntactically truncated, missing its closing brace). Both retries produced clean, complete, correctly-detected results. The R-ERROR result below is from THIS run's ordinary, undisturbed dispatch (not retried) and is a genuine model-judgment outcome: the reviewer's prose and finding summary precisely and correctly describe R-ERROR's actual seeded defect (storage.sh swallowing backend failures as an empty success result) but rated its severity as 'suggestion' rather than 'material'/'blocking', so it does not count as a detection under the committed scorer's material_severities threshold.
phase_3_note: Per decision doc, Reviewer effort experiments (high vs xhigh) belong to Phase 3 under approved conditions only; not evaluated or changed in Phase R.
cost_correction_note: I1 CORRECTION (2026-09-04, post-hoc): dispatch-fixture.sh's cost/credit figures cited throughout this record were undercounted by a step_finish cost-overwrite bug (fixed in commit 505d35a) that summed only the LAST turn's cost instead of every turn's cost for each multi-step dispatch. Corrected observed_cost/derived_credits for every dispatch with surviving raw.jsonl evidence are recorded in each dispatch.json's cost_correction block and in models/routing/opencode/eval/records/phase-r/budget-ledger.json's i1_correction block. canonical_cost_reference is corrected to false: this record's own inline cost figures predate the fix and are known-undercounted; do not cite them for budget accounting.
fixture_defect_note: FIXTURE_DEFECT (2026-09-04, Reviewer fixture-integrity remediation): clean/pagination.sh (and, by inheritance, every case sandbox's unmodified copy of it -- all six sandboxes include clean/pagination.sh) carried a real, mechanically-proven defect (bash reinterprets leading-zero numeric strings as octal; see decimal-pagination-test.sh / fixture-defect-detectors.sh) at the time this dispatch ran. This violates the fixture's own committed invariant that clean/ has zero known material defects. Per this remediation's classification, ALL Reviewer Phase-R quality results produced against this defective fixture revision are INADMISSIBLE as Phase-R Reviewer quality gate evidence -- retained here as diagnostic/historical evidence only. A valid Reviewer gate rerun must restart from zero (all 5 seeded cases + clean control) against the fixture-integrity-proven revision fixed in commit d9d6235, not be spliced together from this and a new run.
